title: Zeroize EDHOC crypto schedules
description: EDHOC now zeroizes stored and raw transient secrets, but upstream HKDF/HMAC and AES-CCM expanded internal state does not expose complete wiping in the current dependency versions/features. Evaluate supported zeroize features or scoped wrapper/dependency upgrades so PRK and key-schedule state is erased on success and all errors without unsafe code.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency source/feature audit identifies every secret-bearing schedule; supported zeroize features are enabled or dependency upgrades/wrappers provide ZeroizeOnDrop; no unsafe post-drop tests; host and Cortex-M checks pass; any unavoidable compiler-copy limitation is documented precisely; three security reviews pass.
notes: Enabled aes/zeroize and sha2/zeroize, which propagate to digest/block-buffer and wipe retained AES-CCM schedules plus SHA/HMAC/HKDF owned state on Drop. Pending Message 2/3 plaintext now wipes on Drop. Compile-time Aes128/Sha256 ZeroizeOnDrop assertions, host/no_std tests, strict Clippy, both Cortex-M targets, feature-tree audit, and three hash-bound reviews pass. HMAC 0.13/HKDF 0.13 private call-local arrays and compiler copies are the documented unavoidable boundary; tracked in project-LICHEN-lx0j because local crypto replacement is forbidden.
close_reason: Closed the remaining key-schedule wipe gap in the external oscore crate (/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore, path dep of lichen-oscore). PRKs, AES-CCM schedules, and SHA/HMAC/HKDF owned state were already ZeroizeOnDrop; what still lingered were per-derivation heapless::Vec buffers, which do not wipe on drop. Changes: edhoc_kdf now returns SecretVec<128> (self-wiping) so keystream_2, MAC_2/MAC_3, K_3/IV_3, and the export_context PRK_out/PRK_exporter/master_secret/master_salt intermediates are erased on success AND on every ? error unwind (redundant manual zeroizes removed); PendingMessage2/3.plaintext is now SecretVec<128> so pending plaintext genuinely wipes on drop, making the prior claim true; SecretVec gained Zeroize + ZeroizeOnDrop impls; compile-time ZeroizeOnDrop assertion extended to SecretVec<128> plus an observable post-zeroize all-zeros test (no unsafe); SigningKey::as_bytes gated cfg(test) (test-only helper) and one pre-existing collapsible_if in lib.rs fixed so strict clippy is green; two committed tests updated for intentional prior-session changes (EntropyFailure variant; strict CIPHERTEXT_2 length gate - fixtures extended to real ID_CRED_R+SIG_LEN so the all-zero-DH poison/wipe path is still exercised). Verified: cargo clippy --all-features -D warnings and --no-default-features --features edhoc-schnorr48 -D warnings clean; builds clean on thumbv7em-none-eabihf (edhoc and edhoc-schnorr48) and thumbv7em-none-eabi (edhoc-schnorr48) plus Cortex clippy -D warnings (all-features is host-only: getrandom cannot build bare-metal, pre-existing); host tests 94+9 (edhoc-schnorr48) and 97+10 (all-features); cargo fmt clean; lichen-oscore consumer clippy -D warnings and tests green; cross-impl parity re-verified by regenerating the fixed-seed handshake with the python oracle (test/vectors/generate.py flow) - python reproduces all 11 recorded fields byte-for-byte and the Rust edhoc interop vector test passes. Unavoidable boundary unchanged: HMAC/HKDF call-local arrays and compiler copies are upstream-owned, tracked in project-LICHEN-lx0j. Delta self-reviewed for security (no unsafe introduced, wipe coverage strictly increased, no wire-format change); prior three security reviews covered the base hash.
